title: Determination of Drug Interactions of Certain Nasal Medications With Intranasal Ketamine
brief_summary: This is an open label, single-center study to determine whether certain nasal medication interact with PMI-150 (intranasal ketamine) 30 mg in healthy adult volunteers and in patients with allergic rhinitis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Healthy adults
* Patients with Allergic Rhinitis

Exclusion Criteria:

* Under age 18
